title: Local and durable background jobs
description: Bounded job worker with progress, retries, cancellation, idempotency and SQLite restart recovery.
limitations: Memory mode is non-durable; SQLite requires a persistent single-host filesystem.
At-least-once execution requires idempotent external effects and cooperative cancellation.
